name: Ron Smoorenburg
bio: Ron Smoorenburg (born 30 April 1974) is a Dutch martial artist and actor. He is best known for the end fight in Jackie Chan’s “Who am I?”, 1998. Ron worked with the best action stars and directors known today and developed himself in the last 20 years as an actor with a versatile and experienced action background. In “Warriors Gate” 2016 (Luc Besson), Ron plays one of the main heroes: “The Black Knight”.
